ns2:section.sectionText: Proper data communication and storytelling begins even before data is analyzed and there are proven strategies to better connect the story behind and from the data to relevant stakeholders, especially within the context of business practice. This course will focus on helping students better position themselves to successfully tell the persuasive story flowing from their data. This course will open to students all campus Sophomore, Junior, and Senior level students on January 6 at 10:00 am CST
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to students with Sophomore, Junior, or Senior class standing.
